newsitem.title: USA: Energy Secretary O'Leary to quit -official source.
newsitem.headline: Energy Secretary O'Leary to quit -official source.

text.p: U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary is stepping down from the Clinton Administration, an Energy Department source said Wednesday.
"I'm calling to confirm that Secretary O'Leary is leaving," the source said.
"She plans to stay until the end of the first term or until a successor has been named," the source said.
O'Leary, who came under fire in Congress over the last year for her extensive overseas travels, had long said she planned to serve for only one term.
O'Leary had no comment on her future plans.

Various names have been circulating as possible replacements, including Deputy Secretary Charles Curtis, Representative Bill Richardson, a New Mexico Democrat, and retiring Sen. Bennett Johnston, a Louisiana Democrat.
